home_intro: The interface is being built. Its tokens, type, motion, icons and formats are on one page.
ui_intro: Tokens, type, space, motion, icons and formats as they ship, in the theme, density, motion and language chosen above.
ui_colour_intro: Semantic roles as the browser paints them in the current theme. Values and ratios are measured live from the page, not copied from the spec.
ui_colour_matrix_note: Text needs 4.5:1. ink-disabled is for disabled controls only and is exempt.
ui_type_intro: Eight steps from 11 to 28 px. Devanagari keeps its case and tracking and gets 0.15 more line height.
ui_type_caption: Meta text, receipt pills, secondary table text
ui_type_small: Dense tables, side columns, secondary buttons
ui_type_mono: IBM Plex Mono: hashes, ids, commands and code
ui_type_figures: Tabular figures in the UI, proportional in prose
ui_space_intro: Eleven spacing steps and nothing else, three densities, six radii and four opaque elevations.
ui_space_nesting: Nested shapes: inner radius = outer radius − padding
ui_motion_intro: Named durations and easings. Under reduced motion nothing moves: each demo fades in place for 120 ms or less.
ui_motion_calm: Cards entering, popovers, expand and collapse
ui_motion_deliberate: Rail state changes: ring closing, mark drawing
ui_motion_ambient: The violet light pass and the status line's dwell
ui_motion_rise: rise: enter, then exit in two thirds of the time
ui_motion_stagger: Stagger: 40 ms apart, 8 items at most
ui_motion_expand: Expand and collapse: grid rows from 0fr to 1fr at calm
ui_motion_expand_body: Rows expand inline instead of hiding details in tooltips. Nothing jumps in height.
ui_icons_intro: Phosphor for every icon, in the weight the running app uses in each place: 16 px in rows and menus, 18 px in the sidebar and top bar. 4CE's own concepts use the closest regular glyph; a verdict settles in once when it arrives live.
ui_concept_observation: A reading with its box and number
ui_format_intro: One module for every number, unit, time and hash, in the active locale. Missing values print —.
composer_placeholder: Ask about your documents, or give 4CE a task
